svg.text: A Deep Agent on your own data, inside a sandbox
one question in, a cited brief out: the agent plans and delegates; the database and the gateway decide what it can reach
memory: /memories/ in OracleStore · checkpoints in OracleSaver
gate: accepts the brief only if every cited id exists
agent X reads SYN-X, proposes for SYN-X;
approval and execution belong to the clinician
lead openai.gpt-5.5 · specialists google.gemini-2.5-flash · the proxy swaps the placeholder in transit
nothing else is reachable: no rule, no connection
